wedge_sentence: Two-click tax filing for solo Shopify bookkeepers.

decisions.reason: Shopify DTC bookkeepers under-served by generalist tools

decisions.decision: GTM: services-first now, PLG (01e) as Phase 2; adopt free audit scanner + tiered pricing now
decisions.reason: CEO review: services-first is cash-positive and retires demand risk before spending AI tokens; PLG free-tier COGS is unproven and demand is unproven — sequence, don't fork. Funded by services revenue.

decisions.decision: PLG free-tier viability gated on cost-per-ideation-run, not conversion
decisions.reason: cogs-model.sh sweep: at ~$0.50/run healthy even @1% conv; at ~$3.00/run underwater below ~1.3% conv. Free tier must use cheap/cached ideation model + hard credit caps. Re-run with real token costs before Phase 2 greenlight.
